name: Sawai Kana
source:
She is the mother of the main character “Takuma” and a single mother. She is sorry that “Mari” has to take care of Takuma because she is working. 

She is ready to do anything for Takuma. 

"I'll work hard for my son, who I'm proud of."

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_036/amml_036.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
